verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents a REST API, an admin MCP server that grants AI tools write access, and Enterprise RBAC for team members. None of the evidence describes issuing API keys or tokens with restricted scopes or least-privilege permissions for an agent. The read-only Index MCP server and user RBAC are adjacent features, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
